security_audit.summary: The skill is mostly Markdown guidance with examples, and most static external command hits are Markdown fence false positives. The quick start includes a confirmed curl-to-shell install pattern, which is a real supply-chain execution risk even though it is presented as documentation. No prompt injection or covert data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Pipe-to-shell installer in the quick start
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-shell command with manual install steps, pinned release downloads, and explicit checksum verification before execution.

remediation.issue: Installer URL appears inside an executable example
remediation.suggestion: Move installation guidance out of agent-facing command examples and require user confirmation before any download, login, or account-linked action.

remediation.issue: Executable CLI examples are mixed with prompt-writing guidance
remediation.suggestion: Label CLI blocks as examples only, or convert them to non-executable instructions when the skill is used only for prompt drafting.

content.value_statement: AI video prompts often fail when they miss shot, motion, lighting, or style details. This skill provides clear structures, examples, and model tips for stronger results.
actual_capabilities: Provides a prompt formula covering shot type, subject, action, setting, lighting, style, and technical details.
Lists shot types and camera movements with practical use cases.
Groups lighting, style, and quality keywords for faster prompt drafting.
Provides prompt examples for product, nature, urban, food, and futuristic scenes.
Summarizes model-specific tips for Veo, Seedance, Wan, and Grok.
Shows an iterative workflow for improving prompts step by step.
limitations: It does not generate videos by itself; it guides prompt writing and shows CLI examples.
Model behavior, names, and availability may change outside the skill.
It does not verify rights, factual claims, or safety of generated video content.
CLI examples require an inference.sh account and local infsh setup.

use_cases.title: Draft Campaign Video Prompts
use_cases.description: Turn a product concept into a structured video prompt with shot, lighting, and style details.

use_cases.title: Plan Creative Tests
use_cases.description: Create prompt variations that compare camera movement, lighting, style, and model fit.

use_cases.title: Document Prompt Standards
use_cases.description: Build repeatable prompt patterns for teams that need consistent AI video output.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Video Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to turn my idea into one concise AI video prompt. Idea: [describe scene]. Include shot type, subject, action, setting, lighting, style, and technical details.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Weak Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to improve this video prompt: [paste prompt]. Keep the same intent, then add clearer camera movement, lighting, setting, and style terms.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Model Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to recommend the best video model for this goal: [goal]. Compare Veo, Seedance, Wan, and Grok based on motion, realism, references, and duration.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Iteration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a four-step prompt iteration plan for: [video concept]. Each step should change one variable and explain the expected visual effect.

output_examples.input: A vague request for a video of a phone on a table.
output_examples.output: A refined prompt describes a smooth tracking shot around the phone, soft studio lighting, clean reflections, product style, and shallow depth of field.

output_examples.input: A creator wants a nature clip with strong motion and close detail.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests an extreme close-up, slow motion, wing motion blur, golden-hour lighting, and documentary styling for a focused result.

output_examples.input: A team needs to improve a first prompt after weak output.
output: Add style and quality terms last.

best_practices: Define one scene per prompt with clear subject, action, camera movement, and lighting.
Add style and technical terms only when they support the visual goal.
Iterate from simple prompts to detailed prompts while changing one variable at a time.
anti_patterns: Asking for multiple unrelated scenes in a single generation prompt.
Combining contradictory styles that make model priorities unclear.
Omitting motion, camera direction, or lighting when these elements matter.

faq.question: Does this skill generate video files?
faq.answer: No. It helps write better AI video prompts and shows examples for video generation tools.

faq.question: Which video models does it mention?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for Veo, Seedance, Wan, Grok, Kling, Runway, Pika, and Sora style prompting.

faq.question: Can I use it without inference.sh?
faq.answer: Yes. The prompting guidance is general, although some examples use the inference.sh CLI.

faq.question: Is it useful for image-to-video work?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes model notes for image-to-video workflows and reference-based motion planning.

faq.question: How should I start with a new idea?
faq.answer: Start with one scene, then add shot type, subject, action, setting, lighting, style, and technical details.

faq.question: What should I avoid in prompts?
faq.answer: Avoid vague requests, conflicting styles, missing motion, missing lighting, and too many scenes in one prompt.
